findings.summary: worker_threads is not confined; a Worker isolate can drop the preload and write outside allowed_paths.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Preload MUST intercept worker_threads.Worker so nested isolates inherit capturedPolicy confinement or construction is fail-closed. RED: sandboxed Worker({eval:true, execArgv:[]}) write outside workspace MUST be blocked or rejected.

findings.summary: fs.link* only authorizes newPath; a hardlink to an outside inode can be mutated via an inside name.
findings.acceptance_criteria: link/linkSync/promises.link MUST fail closed unless both existingPath and newPath resolve inside captured allowed_paths. Adversarial test: link(outside, allowedRel) then write(allowedRel) MUST NOT mutate the outside inode.

findings.summary: fd/FileHandle mutating APIs (fchmod/fchown/futimes) are wrapped but not exercised by tests.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Runtime test: openSync(undeclared, r) then fchmodSync(fd) MUST throw EACCES. Mutation-surface inventory MUST invoke those wrappers.

findings.summary: Malformed OSPEC_SANDBOX_ALLOWED_PATHS fail-opens to ** and capturedPolicy freezes that policy.
findings.acceptance_criteria: If rawAllowedPaths is missing, unparseable, or not an array, preload MUST fail closed (no default **).

findings.summary: Empty catch around fileURLToPath can skip assertWriteAllowed and still run original fs.
findings.acceptance_criteria: If path conversion fails, the wrapper MUST throw EACCES fail-closed rather than return and invoke the original method.

findings.summary: executeSandboxedCommand abort sends SIGTERM only and finishes immediately; no SIGKILL escalation.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Abort MUST escalate to SIGKILL after a bounded wait, matching the local spawn path in worker-executor.js.

findings.summary: Isolation probe mkdtemp pair runs before try; second failure leaks externalRoot.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Both temp dirs MUST be created inside a try/finally that rmSyncs any successfully created path.

findings.summary: isolationReported assignment in executeWorkOrder is nested four levels deep.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Extract a named helper that returns isolationReported or a fail-closed result so the enforced assignment is a single obvious path.

findings.summary: isolationCapability names WorkerTransport state but error strings say isolation; easy to misread as WorkerIsolation.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Comment or rename the declared transport capability vs WorkerIsolation bundle so isolationReported cannot inherit the wrong proof.

findings.summary: capturedPolicy is passed next to a process.env spread without stating that OSPEC_SANDBOX_* are rebuilt from the snapshot.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Comment confineChildEnv call sites that live process.env is not the sandbox policy authority (ADR-001).

findings.summary: isLiveIsolationProbeEvidence returns true when containment is missing; executor re-checks PASS/BLOCKED/BLOCKED.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Either require containment in the probe predicate or document why it is optional and keep a single authority for the triple.

findings.summary: JSDoc still says puerto WorkerIsolation while the call site passes WorkerTransport.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Correct JSDoc so WorkerIsolation is a capability on WorkerTransport, not a sixth port.

findings.summary: WorkerTransport handler fallback order between primitives.worker and workerIsolation is uncommented.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Comment the fallback so probe and command share the executing transport fingerprint.
